audience: spa and salon owners who take bookings with Wellknown

useCases.title: Review new and changed bookings
useCases.text: List the bookings that changed since a point in time and open one to read the details.

useCases.title: Find open times for a treatment
useCases.text: List the treatments and check the open times of one treatment.

useCases.title: Set special opening hours
useCases.text: Set the hours for single dates, such as a holiday or a late opening.

useCases.title: Block time for a closure
useCases.text: Replace the blocked times of the venue, for example for a staff day.
